title: Parse a human-readable byte size such as 1.5 KiB
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It maps kB, MB, GB and TB to powers of 1024, so "20 MB" returns 20971520 instead of the 20000000 the brief requires.
A fullmatch over the exact unit spellings validates the input and exact Fraction arithmetic rounds halves up as the brief requires.
It multiplies floats and uses round(), which rounds halves to even, so "2.5 B" returns 2 and "1.0005 kB" returns 1000 instead of 3 and 1001.
Hand validation of digits, one optional space and the unit, followed by integer arithmetic, gives the exact half-up result for every valid size and ValueError otherwise.
